constraints: Add tests only. Do not modify the production source under auto_ingest/; the defect must still be present so the new test can detect it.
Your new test file must live directly in the tests directory of this project so the harness can discover it.
The test must not require a live Neo4j instance, network access, credentials, or media tooling.

The test must assert the lifecycle contract (graph reads and planning happen while the driver is open; the driver is closed exactly once on every exit path), not merely that close() is called somewhere.
known_regression: A regression test that only asserts driver.close() was called passes against the buggy code and therefore detects nothing. The harness proves discrimination: the new test must fail on the unrepaired snapshot and pass on the repaired one.
problem: The `plan` subcommand in auto_ingest/shorts/cli.py has a driver-lifetime defect: planning runs after the driver has been closed, and because the downstream content mining swallows exceptions the failure never surfaces. No test covers this. Add a regression test that fails against the current source and would pass once the ordering is corrected. Do not fix the defect itself.
title: Add the missing regression test for the shorts plan driver lifetime
